verses.text: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
lines: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh,
to sing praises to your name, Most High,

verses.text: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
lines: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning,
and your faithfulness every night,

verses.text: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
lines: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp,
and with the melody of the lyre.

verses.text: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
lines: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work.
I will triumph in the works of your hands.

verses.text: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
lines: How great are your works, Yahweh!
Your thoughts are very deep.

verses.text: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
lines: A senseless man doesn’t know,
neither does a fool understand this:

verses.text: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
lines: though the wicked spring up as the grass,
and all the evildoers flourish,
they will be destroyed forever.

verses.text: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
lines: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

verses.text: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
lines: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh,
for, behold, your enemies shall perish.
All the evildoers will be scattered.

verses.text: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
lines: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox.
I am anointed with fresh oil.

verses.text: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
lines: My eye has also seen my enemies.
My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

verses.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
lines: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree.
He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.text: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
lines: They are planted in Yahweh’s house.
They will flourish in our God’s courts.

verses.text: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
lines: They will still produce fruit in old age.
They will be full of sap and green,

verses.text: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
lines: to show that Yahweh is upright.
He is my rock,
and there is no unrighteousness in him.
